title: Multipliers and Disjointness from Mixing
summary: In 2005, Parreau proved that if a measure preserving system is not strongly mixing then it contains a non-trivial factor that is disjoint from every strongly mixing system. Taking this construction as the starting point, we develop the complementary notions of $\mathcal U$-generated and $\mathcal U$-mixing systems, for a set $\mathcal U$ of ultrafilters, and use them to recover several classical results in ergodic theory as special cases of a unified framework.
